tex_content.html:
Lemma
[Ricci curvature bounds change the metric] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0256 1. ch14:14.1\group Metric Comparison

Let $g(t)$, $t\in [0,T)$, be a Ricci flow and let $\mathcal U$ be an open subset of the manifold.

  1. If $\operatorname {Rc}\le K_1g$ on $\mathcal U\times [0,T)$, then

    \[ g(x,t)\ge e^{-2K_1T}g(x,0). \]

  2. If $\operatorname {Rc}\ge -K_2g$ on $\mathcal U\times [0,T)$, then

    \[ g(x,t)\le e^{2K_2T}g(x,0). \]

Proof

\sketch For $0\ne V\in T_xM$, the Ricci flow equation gives

\[ \log \frac{g(t)(V,V)}{g(0)(V,V)} =-2\int _0^t\frac{\operatorname {Rc}_{g(s)}(V,V)}{g(s)(V,V)}\, ds. \]

In the first case the integrand is at most $K_1$, and in the second it is at least $-K_2$. Integrating and exponentiating proves both inequalities.

□
